First-touch grading (triage seat, session `session_014tGY3fzu4uwCoe7HrfUtWg`): **promoted to `pm:queue`, type Task.**

Rationale: the trade-off the PR left on the record is real, but the residue is exactly the declared≠enforced shape this codebase keeps paying for — a doc comment ("a picker MUST consult catalogErrors") doing a type's job, one `?? []` away from silently reintroducing the #5170 defect class. The filer measured reachability (11 sites + 1) and the fixture blast radius (~17 lines / 5 files), so the union-at-the-boundary move is priced, mechanical, and makes the wrong read a compile error at exactly the sites that must decide what failure looks like.

Dispatch notes: do it together with #5227 (the fourth loader needs new render wiring anyway and becomes the first consumer of the tightened contract) — same file surface, so one claim or explicit serialization, the lane PM's call. Size/model suggestion: M, opus.

Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (per the triage seat).
Clause-②: no — this **tightens a type at a boundary**. Nothing widens; the accepted set of authored metadata does not move at all. What changes is that a caller which ignores the failure channel stops compiling.
Serial constraints cleared, with one live note: **`packages/app-shell` is being touched by #5216 right now (PR5354 open)** — but in different subtrees (`src/hooks/`, `src/urlParams.ts`, `src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, `src/console/home/`, `src/environment/`), not `src/views/metadata-admin/`. That is the maintainer's 2026-08-18 **app-shell subdirectory-level serial exemption**, and its four replacement disciplines bind you: **(a)** declare your file surface to region level, **(b)** merge `main` once before opening the PR, **(c)** merge `main` again after PR5354 lands, **(d)** if you conflict, let the merge queue arbitrate — ⛔ do not hand-order anything. The exemption ⛔ does not extend outside `packages/app-shell`.

## ⚠️ The dispatch note on this card is STALE — read this before you plan

The triage comment says:

> Dispatch notes: **do it together with #5227** (the fourth loader needs new render wiring anyway and becomes the first consumer of the tightened contract) — same file surface, so one claim or explicit serialization, the lane PM's call.

**#5227 has landed.** Closed `completed` 2026-08-18 22:36Z via merged PR **#5263**. So there is nothing to bundle, and the situation is *better* than the note assumed: **the first consumer of the tightened contract already exists in the tree.** Read PR5263 before you start — it is your reference implementation, and the union it consumed (`loadState.ts`, added by PR5226, mirroring the one PR5110 landed for the References panel) plus the shared `PickerLoadFailure` render are both already in place.

That makes this **wiring, not design** — the card says so itself, and it is now more true than when it was written.

## What is actually wrong

The residue PR5226 left on the record is the shape this codebase keeps paying for: **a doc comment doing a type's job.** `WidgetContext` still spells a failed option catalog as an **empty array**, with the fault parked on a side channel — and the contract that a picker *must* consult `catalogErrors` lives in a comment. One `?? []` away from silently reintroducing the **#5170 / #5169** defect class: a failure rendered as a completed, empty list.

The filer priced the move: **11 reachable sites + 1**, fixture blast radius **~17 lines across 5 files**. **Re-measure both on today's `main`** — the card is ~24 hours old and this directory has taken at least two merges since (PR5263, PR5327).

The move: **union at the boundary**, so the wrong read is a **compile error at exactly the sites that must decide what failure looks like**. That is the whole value — ⛔ do not implement it as a runtime check, and ⛔ do not leave a `?? []` convenience overload that lets a caller opt out of deciding.

## Tests

- A **successful empty** catalog and a **failed** catalog are distinguishable at the type level and render differently — this is the defect; pin both.
- Every migrated call site renders the shared `PickerLoadFailure` on the failure arm, matching what PR5263 did. ⛔ Do not invent a second failure presentation.
- A call site that ignores the failure arm **does not compile.** ⚠️ This one needs a type-level assertion or an explicit `@ts-expect-error` pin, not a runtime test — say which you used and why it actually fails when the union is loosened.
- Nothing else in `metadata-admin` regresses.

Reverse-verify: restore the old shape, keep the tests, **predict which go red before running**, report predicted vs observed. ⚠️ Expect a mixed direction here — a type-level pin fails at `tsc`, not in vitest, so **say per leg which tool reports the failure**, and state whether a build artifact sits between the edit and the thing under test (`app-shell` type-checks against `@object-ui/*` built `dist`, so at least one leg will need the dependency closure built — PR5346's dev hit exactly that and reported it).

## Gates

Derive from your diff (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is **objectstack-only**). Run vitest **from the repo root** — the reason is not that package-scoped runs are refused (17 packages own a standalone `vitest.config.ts` and are not refused) but that a package-scoped run uses **a different config than CI does**. ⚠️ `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` gives a **false red** (`TS2307` on every workspace import) unless the dependency closure is built first — build it, and say you did. Changeset per `check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s verdict; `patch` or `minor`, ⛔ **never `major`**.

⛔ Do not background a long check and end your turn. ⛔ No exhaustive paginated API sweeps.

## Deliver

Draft PR against `main`, first body line `Fixes #5228`. Push the branch early. Return the JSON report and post it as a comment whose first line is the literal `<!-- os-dev-report -->` marker.

### Notes for the PM, outside the JSON

- **The card's dispatch note was stale and the correction held**: #5227 had landed via PR #5263, so there was nothing to bundle, and PR5263 was used as the reference implementation throughout — the shared `PickerLoadFailure` render was reused at every migrated site and no second failure presentation was invented.
- **File surface, exact** (all inside the declared region `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**`, disjoint from PR5354's subtrees): `loadState.ts`, `widgets.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `SchemaForm.tsx` (comment only), `inspectors/ViewVariantInspector.tsx`, plus fixtures `SchemaForm.widgetLabelling.test.tsx`, `FilterModeWidget.test.tsx`, `SchemaForm.actionObjectPicker.test.tsx`, `ViewRefWidget.test.tsx`, `selector-placeholder.i18n.test.tsx`, the new `WidgetContext.catalogUnion.test.tsx`, and `.changeset/widget-context-catalog-load-state-5228.md`. 12 files, +864/-223.
- **Serial disciplines (a)–(d)** for the app-shell subdirectory-level exemption are recorded in the PR body. (b) is done — `main` was merged before opening and was already up to date at 58398ba52. **(c) is still outstanding and is not mine to time**: `main` must be merged again after PR5354 (#5216) lands.
- `skip-changeset` was **not** applied and no label was created — this PR carries a real changeset, and per the dispatch that label does not exist as a mechanism in this repo.
- Report delivered at draft-PR time per the 2026-08-10 ruling; CI convergence is the PM's to read. No CI polling was done.
